hypothesis: Magnetic edge ridge (horizontal-gradient / total-horizontal-derivative ridge over the 19-band training stack, catalogue-free, length-gated) marks fault-like linear features missing from the USGS catalogue.
mechanism: Magnetic edge ridges can trace lithological and structural contacts, and faults may coincide with such contacts. Not verified for hidden new faults.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithological contacts, intrusive margins and magnetic edges from basement geometry without faulting; raster artefacts along invalid-sentinel edges (masked, dilated 2 px).
